text:
Anya S: security-bot triggered an audit alert at 1823456778 — service-account `joiner` performed READ on `s3://customer_backups/` in prod. Anybody recall recent RBAC refactor?
security-bot: [ALERT] policy-change-detector: role_binding_change detected for principal=joiner resource=s3:customer_backups action=read
Leo (infra): rolling up — that `joiner` service was supposed to only have metadata access (list) not object read. Suspect role inheritance from `internal-job` got merged.
Jordan (eng-runtime): I just reviewed the policy generator PR (https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/412) — there was a change to role composition that renamed `job-basic` -> `job-base` and added `inherits: [storage-reader]` for convenience. Could be accidental.
Sam P (secops): can someone revoke immediately? I can run emergency ACL if you give me resource id.
Mira (prod-sre): Confirming prod backup bucket is `arn:aws:s3:::customer_backups`. No object deletion observed. Only read logs.
Leo (infra): done — revoked binding: `rbacctl revoke-binding --principal joiner --resource arn:aws:s3:::customer_backups --perm read`
Anya S: Nice. Push a short-lived deny as well? Add `deny: read` rule on that resource for joiner until we patch generator.
Jordan (eng-runtime): patch incoming: revert the inheritance line and add explicit roles. I'll open a hotfix PR and target master.
security-bot: Deploy job queued — assign: @Jordan. CI shows failing tests around role-resolution in simulator.
Sam P (secops): Also rotating the joiner service key in KMS now: `kms rotate-key --key-id alias/joiner-key` and will block old key.
Mira (prod-sre): Logged the incident — creating incident ticket: INC-2026-041 (short description: joiner read on customer backups).
Anya S: We need audit log playback for 24h — what objects were accessed and which customers affected. @Leo can you export CloudTrail S3Read events?
Leo (infra): exporting now, will share CSV to #eng-security artifacts.
Jordan (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/420 — removes inheritance, adds explicit `storage-list-only` and test coverage for role composition.
Sam P (secops): After key rotation, I've also updated quick-alert rule to fire on `s3:GetObject` by service accounts.
Anya S: Good. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) add unit test to policy generator to assert no implicit inheritance, 3) run eval of all service accounts for over-privileged perms.
Mira (prod-sre): Acknowledged, will schedule a 30m triage at 15:30 PT.
Jordan (eng-runtime): Rolling hotfix now — will rollback if anything breaks.
Anya S: Thanks. Keep the thread updated. :eyes:
